name: ChatGPT for Teens
desc: The under-18 experience in ChatGPT, with study mode and parent controls.
desc_zh: ChatGPT 面向 18 岁以下用户的版本，带学习模式和家长控制。
solves: A teen asking for a quick answer gets handed one. This experience pushes back toward the steps, and a parent can see and set the limits.
solves_zh: 孩子直接要答案时，普通助手会给。这个版本会把话题推回解题步骤，家长也能查看并设定限制。
best_for: Someone under 18 is using ChatGPT for schoolwork outside class.
best_for_zh: 家里有未满 18 岁的孩子，要在课外用 ChatGPT 赶功课和准备考试。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI news, https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-teens）。 Applied automatically when age is estimated or stated as 13-17, so it is a configuration of ChatGPT rather than a separate app. Distinct from ChatGPT Study mode, which the ledger already has. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-teens
